title.narrative: UNICEF led efforts in Early Childhood Development (ECD), increasing coverage from 14% to 22% in 2023-2024. Growth monitoring rose from 20.2% to 27%. UNICEF supported the Ministry of Health with technical assistance, regulatory documents, training, and supplies, enhancing healthcare services, especially neonatal health and ECD screenings.
